newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish oil tanker explosion kills five.
newsitem.headline: Turkish oil tanker explosion kills five.

text.p: Five people were killed in an explosion which damaged a large Turkish oil tanker in waters off a shipyard near Istanbul, Turkey's state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.
It said the blast was caused by a welding operation in an empty fuel tank of the 155,000-tonne Gole, Turkey's second biggest tanker on Wednesday.
The explosion killed four workers instantly and a fifth died from severe burns in hospital overnight, the agency said.
The Gole was anchored near a shipyard at Tuzla, south of Istanbul in the Marmara Sea, where it had been taken for maintenance.
It was the first tanker to transport Iraqi oil from a port in southeast Turkey last December under the United Nations oil-for-food deal.
In February, a fire rendered unusable Turkey's largest tanker, the 159,982-tonne TPAO. Two people were killed and 27 injured then.
